summary: This note is a short wiki-style biography of Javier Castilla Conde, a professional male squash player who represented Colombia. It records his birth date and place and his career-high world ranking, reached after he joined the Professional Squash Association in 2006.
one_line: Javier Castilla Conde is a Colombian professional male squash player who reached a career-high world ranking of No. 186 in 2007.
key_facts: Javier Castilla Conde was born on April 18, 1981, in Bogotá.
Javier Castilla Conde is a professional male squash player who represented Colombia.
Javier Castilla Conde reached a career-high world ranking of World No. 186.
Javier Castilla Conde reached his career-high world ranking in March 2007.
Javier Castilla Conde joined the Professional Squash Association (PSA) in 2006.
